Notus2.definition: Notus or Notos ī, m , *no/tos, the south wind, V., H., O.: tendunt vela Noti, the winds, V.

Novensiles.definition: Novēnsilēs ium, m novem+SED-, newly settled : divi, newly introduced , L. (old prayer).
